answer: Tiered Attention Ledger. Each identity earns standing only by maintaining an unbroken hourly activity record; gaps decay rank irreversibly, like a terrace eroding from its edge. To register many identities, an attacker must split scarce sustained attention across all of them, so each one stays below useful thresholds. A single missed window costs that identity its accumulated pearl of rank, forcing costly re-earning. Marginal identities sink into the lagoon of unranked noise.
